nodes.label: SeatHand (per-seat visibility-aware hand)
nodes.rationale: Shipped as a new type instead of renaming the existing HoleCards because HoleCards(Vec<Two>) has ~21 callers in analysis/ and play/stages/ treating it as an equity-analysis collection; renaming would churn 21 files for no semantic gain. Added alongside (not replacing) SeatNoCell.cards: BoxedCards because BoxedCards carries slot-oriented semantics that don't fit the append-only visibility model.
